appearance:
Appearance

Field repaints the outer surface and Dropdown repaints both option lists; Preview colors the plain-words line and the expression chip; RadioStyle colors the mode radios.

Usage 

@uiForm.CronSchedule(uiForm.CronScheduleSettings{
	Label:           "Cron Schedule",
	TwoWayStatePath: "schedule",

	// OptionalFields
	Dropdown: uiForm.CronScheduleDropdownStyle{
		BackgroundColor: "violet-900",
		BorderColor:     "violet-500/40",
		BorderRadius:    uiToolset.BorderRadiusLg,
	},
	Field: uiForm.CronScheduleFieldStyle{
		BackgroundColor: "violet-950",
		BorderColor:     "violet-500/40",
		BorderRadius:    uiToolset.BorderRadiusLg,
	},
	Preview: uiForm.CronSchedulePreviewStyle{
		TextColor:           "violet-100",
		CodeBackgroundColor: "violet-500/20",
		CodeTextColor:       "violet-200",
	},
	RadioStyle: uiForm.RadioInputStyle{
		ActiveColor: "violet-400",
		TextColor:   "violet-100",
	},
})

sizes:
Sizes

Size takes an InputFieldSize constant and scales the label, the trigger, the five fields, and the preview together.

Usage 

@uiForm.CronSchedule(uiForm.CronScheduleSettings{
	Label:           "Cron Schedule",
	TwoWayStatePath: "schedule",

	// OptionalFields
	Size: uiForm.InputFieldSizeLg,
})

validation:
Validation

Each field validates its cron syntax. Type an out-of-range value such as 99 in Minute: the field border turns red and the bound path clears until the schedule is valid again.

Usage 

@uiForm.CronSchedule(uiForm.CronScheduleSettings{
	Label:           "Cron Schedule",
	TwoWayStatePath: "schedule",
})
